notes.title: Playtest Patch v 0.8.26
notes.content:
Since last time, I've worked on:
[list]
[*] Controller support. It was really flimsy, I know, and now it should not be. Woo!
[*] Smaller QoL features, such as being able to undo choices at the Merchant
[*] Added art content, such as card art for Tau and a new opponent (Mummy)
[*] A whole host of bug fixes. There are still some issues left - I know, I'm sorry, but I'm working on it! :D
[/list]

Don't forget to give me your feedback on [url=https://valiant.se/discord]Discord[/url]!

/A

notes.title: Platyest Patch v 0.8.19
notes.content:
Hey friends!
I just fixed some bugs allover, in particular focusing on decreasing lag spikes when panels (such as looking at/upgrading your deck or winning an encounter) are opened. 
I also improved the art of some of the characters I made personally, for lack of better judgement and budget.

Let me know on [url=https://valiant.se/discord]Discord[/url] what you think I should focus on next!

/A
